stem:
Lalit stands in front of a plane mirror and looks at his image. He asks whether the image can be obtained on a screen.

Which set of properties is correct?

options.text: The image is upright, the same size as Lalit, appears behind the mirror and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, smaller than Lalit, appears behind the mirror and cannot be obtained on a screen.
The image is upright, the same size as Lalit, appears behind the mirror and can be obtained on a screen.
Every mirror forms an upright image the same size as the object.

teacher.key_rationale: A plane-mirror image is upright, same size, virtual (behind the mirror, not on a screen). Calling it smaller is a surface size error. Claiming it can be caught on a screen treats it as real. Extending the claim to every mirror over-scopes.
